subject: Clarify streaming billing appendix / commit tiers - Bluewave
messages:
From: Emily Carter <emily@bluewave.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha@bluewave.ai>, procurement@bluewave.ai
Date: 2025-11-02T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Questions on streaming billing / commit tiers

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency profile looked promising for our chat workflows. Before we move to commercial terms, our procurement and engineering teams have three quick questions about how Redwood will bill streaming/chat traffic so we can model costs: 

1) Billable unit definition: do you charge on tokens emitted by the model only, or do you include prompt tokens? How are streaming tokens measured in an incremental/real-time session?

2) Rounding and aggregation: if we stream partial tokens across several micro-responses (e.g., assistant emits bytes incrementally), how does Redwood round or aggregate those fractions? Is rounding per-request, per-session, or at invoice-time?

3) Commit mechanics: we expect bursty weekly spikes. For commit discounts, does unused committed volume carry forward or true-up only? Any minimums or lookback windows we should be aware of?

We attached our sample monthly profile (usage-sample-6000tokens.csv) so you can see a typical session.

Can you share the exact wording you expect in the SOW/appendix so our legal can review?

Best,
Emily Carter
Head of Platform Partnerships
Bluewave Analytics

Attachments: usage-sample-6000tokens.csv (csv)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Carter <emily@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-02T11:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Questions on streaming billing / commit tiers

Hi Emily — great questions, thanks for laying those out clearly. Summary answers up front, followed by proposed contract language (draft appendix attached):

1) Billable unit: Redwood counts billable tokens as the sum of prompt + generated tokens associated with a request. For streaming sessions we meter the emitted tokens as they are produced by the model; the metric we report is "tokens_emitted" per session + "tokens_prompt" per request.

2) Rounding & aggregation: our standard meter rounds to the next whole token at the time the token is emitted (effectively per-token rounding, i.e., no fractional tokens billed). For streaming frames that are partial bytes, we aggregate at the tokenization layer — you will not be billed fractional tokens. This is effectively equivalent to per-request rounding for non-streaming calls, and per-emission rounding for streaming.

3) Commit mechanics: committed volumes are tracked on a monthly basis. We offer a 12-month rolling true-up: committed discounts apply to usage up to the committed tier for each month; unused committed units do not accrue indefinitely but we allow a one-month carryforward equal to 10% of the monthly commit as a buffer for spikes. True-ups happen at the end of each contract quarter.

I've attached a short billing appendix (redwood-billing-appendix-v1.docx) with proposed language. Can you confirm your legal team would like redlines inline or a separate marked-up doc?

Pricing preview (subject to final SOW):
- Baseline list price: $0.0006 / token (prompt+generated)
- 500M-2B tokens/month: 12% discount
- 2B+ tokens/month: 20% discount
- Commitment minimum: 500M tokens/month for the tiered pricing to apply

If that looks directionally right I'll loop in Kimberly and Legal to finalize contract wording — Marissa will own the PO/finance flow.

Thanks,
Sergio
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-billing-appendix-v1.docx (docx)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-03T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: suggested contract redlines for Bluewave billing appendix

Folks — I reviewed Sergio's draft appendix. A few legal/clarity edits to propose before we send to Bluewave:

- Measurement authority: define "billable tokens" as "tokens counted by Redwood's metering pipeline (tokens_prompt + tokens_generated) as recorded in the Redwood billing API at invoice time." This avoids debates about client-side tokenizers.

- Rounding language: replace "rounded to the next whole token" with "rounded up to the nearest whole token at the time tokens are emitted by the model; for streaming, token emissions are recorded as discrete token events and fractional byte frames are aggregated by Redwood's tokenizer prior to billing."

- Streaming sessions: add example to appendix showing a 6,000-token session split across multiple emissions and how it aggregates (we should attach a small sample calc).

- Commit & carryforward: instead of an unlimited 30-day carryforward, cap carryforward to the lesser of 10% of monthly commit or 200M tokens. True-up occur quarterly; any shortfall is invoiced at the applicable negotiated overage rate.

- Audit and disputes: include a 60-day window for dispute of meter reports; provide aHubSpot/report link and on-demand CSV export as accepted reconciliation evidence.

I've created a redline (contract_redline_v2.docx) with line edits and an example calculation table. If everyone is good, we should send a version with the redlines visible and a separate clean appendix.

-Kim
Senior Counsel, Agreements & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Attachments: contract_redline_v2.docx (docx)

Hi Emily — looping in our counsel (Kimberly) and contracts lead (Laura) so you have a single appendix for legal review. Per Kim's redlines we updated the language and added an example calculation. Key points summarized below; full wording is attached as the marked-up redline and a clean copy: 

- Billable tokens: defined to mirror Redwood metering and recorded at invoice time.
- Streaming rounding: token emissions are recorded discretely; fractional byte frames are aggregated at tokenizer boundary; billed tokens are whole tokens (no fractional billing).
- Commit mechanics: monthly tracking, 1-month carryforward buffer up to 10% of monthly commit or 200M tokens (whichever is smaller); quarterly true-up; overages invoiced at the agreed overage rate.
- Discounts: 12% off list for 500M-2B; 20% off for 2B+. Commitment minimum 500M tokens/month required to qualify.

Please review the DocuSign link below where we've pre-filled the SOW + Appendix. If Bluewave wants inline redlines instead of the marked doc, let me know and Kimberly will produce them.
